description: Routing evals for one-time fractal documentation structure setup.

cases.prompt: I want to set up fractal documentation for my new Rust project. Create the docs structure.
cases.expected_output: Should load this skill and create docs/ with the 5 subdirectories plus .agents/skills/fractal-scope/SKILL.md, config.yaml, and scripts/check-scope.js.
expectations: Creates docs/engineering/, docs/research/, docs/postmortem/, docs/specs/, docs/archive/

cases.prompt: Set up fractal docs structure for this repo.
cases.expected_output: Should load this skill and bootstrap the fractal directory tree.
expectations: Reports when fractal docs already exist instead of overwriting
Defaults enabled: false in scope config

cases.prompt: I need to audit the freshness of my docs across decisions/ and AGENTS.md files.
cases.expected_output: Should prefer fractal-audit, not this skill. This is ongoing maintenance, not first-time setup.

cases.prompt: Help me write the AGENTS.md for my src/auth/ directory — I want to document its scope and constraints.
cases.expected_output: Should prefer fractal-agents-fill, not this skill. This is directory-level content authoring, not repo bootstrapping.
